headline: Nine o'clock leans into the dark.
body: Shop shutters have finished their last rattle. A bus idles at the stop with no one boarding, its interior the only bright room on the street. We file the hour and keep the window open.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: clear, one aircraft light crawling west

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet kerb from an earlier shower
